description: Use this when the person asks when suppliers will be reminded about a requested supplier declaration, or who gets the next reminder. Shows, for every open request for a supplier declaration of the connected account, what the nightly run would send next and on which day: the first mail if it failed, the first reminder 7 days or the second 14 days after the request, or nothing (address stopped, due date passed, both reminders sent). It never sends, schedules or changes anything; withdrawing a request or asking again is done in the dashboard, and the tool returns that link. Do not use to send, bring forward or stop a reminder; that is done in the dashboard, and this tool returns the link.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: preview_declaration_reminders
title: Preview of reminders to suppliers
